messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 4299998765 - continuous-batching: sudden throughput collapse and KV-cache runaway in us-west-2. Auto-pager triggered for oncall. Affected service: inference-runtime (continuous-batch path).
Avery: paging in - I'm on it. observed 10x queue growth and microbatch sizes spiking to 64 at high concurrency. tail latency up 5-10s.
Priya: seeing corresponding kv_cache.size metric shoot up from ~120MB -> 3.2GB on several hosts. eviction rate dropped to near 0.
Dmitri: logs show repeated prefetch loop warnings, e.g. `prefetcher: miss->retry loop` and `kv_cache: put failed - no eviction capacity`.
Maya: customer-impact: two tenants report timeouts, reconnects. Platform errors (HTTP 503) increased from 0.2% -> 4.1% in last 5m.
Avery: possible root cause: continuous-batch batching heuristic created very large microbatches due to jitter at high concurrency, causing rapid KV insert churn and eviction thrashing.
Priya: can we throttle prefetch and force microbatch max to 8 as hotfix? I can flip config on the fleet for cb-controller.
Dmitri: agree. Also recommend immediate increase of kv_cache.eviction_budget to allow gradual stabilization.
Avery: doing a targeted hotpatch now. Command to apply (rolling):
```
# cb-controller config override
redwoodctl set-config deployment cb-controller --key continuous_batch.max_microbatch_size --value 8 --rolling
redwoodctl set-config deployment runtime --key kv_cache.eviction_budget --value 0.2 --rolling
```
Priya: running the first command against shard group 7 -> 12 now. monitoring.
SRE Bot: monitor: cb_queue_length[shard=7] at 1200 -> watching.
Maya: note - customer A (enterprise) saw ~30% of requests fail in the last 8m. Escalating to CS to notify.
Dmitri: observed immediate drop in new KV inserts after first roll: inserts/s down 70% on patched hosts. eviction rate slowly rising (good).
Avery: nice, tail latency improving on patched hosts (p99 from 8.3s -> 1.5s). Still some hosts at full memory.
Priya: launching eviction sweep on the remaining hot hosts (non-disruptive): `runtime-admin trigger-evict --group hot`
ops-bot: kicked job runtime-evict-4299998765 on 12 nodes, status queued -> running.
Maya: customer-impact update: tenant B intermittent errors continue (approx 2% of calls), but overall platform error rate trending down.
Dmitri: adding a short-term circuit for prefetcher when mem_pressure > 0.85 to avoid further cache blowouts. Will push rule as emergency policy.
Avery: pushing circuit rule now. command:
```
redwoodctl policy apply emergency-prefetch-cutoff --if mem_pressure>0.85 --action disable_prefetch
```
Priya: policy applied to all us-west-2 runtime pools. seeing prefetcher metrics flatline, kv_cache.size trending down on patched pools.
SRE Bot: alert suppressed for cb_queue_length (muted by oncall) until 4299999000.
Maya: opened incident ticket INC-2026-3278 and added CS notes, ETA to update customers ~30m.
Avery: preparing handoff notes for next oncall: will keep microbatch max=8 and eviction_budget=0.2 for 1h, monitor kv_cache.size and p99. If stable for 30m, gradually relax limits.
Dmitri: follow-up actions: schedule a postmortem to dig into batching heuristic interaction with prefetch; propose a guardrail to cap commit rate when eviction under pressure.
Priya: sanity check - no config rollback needed now. continuing to roll patch to remaining shards.
Maya: customer comms ready, CS will send interim note. impact: limited timeouts, degraded throughput for two tenants; no data loss.
Avery: handoff: oncall -> Priya (next). key checks: `kv_cache.size`, `kv_cache.evictions/s`, `cb_queue_length`, `p99_latency`, and `prefetch_failures`. set pager if errors >1% sustained 5m.
Priya: acknowledged. will monitor for next 4h and run postmortem draft after stabilization.
incident-bot: INCIDENT 4299998765 status -> mitigated (live hotpatches rolled; customer impact reduced). Continue monitoring and file postmortem within 72h. :white_check_mark:
